commentary: Charaka explains that the human constitution is upheld by three supportive pillars: proper nourishment (Ahara), restorative sleep (Swapna/Nidra), and disciplined conservation of vital energy (Brahmacharya). When maintained in equilibrium, they endow the individual with strength (Bala), clarity, and longevity without systemic decay.
application: In the Sadhana Hub, modern sensory and digital consumption is treated as mental Ahara, circadian sleep consistency is logged as Nidra, and focused deep work blocks represent Brahmacharya, transforming habit tracking into holistic energy conservation.

commentary: The Vyasa Bhashya expounds that vitarkas are unwholesome mental impulses rooted in greed, anger, or delusion that lead to unending distress. Pratipaksha Bhavana is the deliberate mental cultivation of the exact opposite, wholesome thought wave, thereby neutralizing cognitive degradation at its root.
application: Powers the Distraction Interceptor modal, interrupting compulsive doomscrolling or impulsive loops by prompting the user to name the vitarka, trace the Gita 2.62-63 cascade, and compose an opposing Sattvic cognitive reframe.

commentary: Shankara Bhashya elucidates that Prana is the vital breath sheath bridging gross physical matter (Annamaya) and cognitive fluctuations (Manomaya). Conscious regulation of respiratory rhythms harmonizes inward Prana and downward Apana, pacifying Rajasic restlessness and inducing mental stillness.
application: Drives the visual Breathing Sanctum, utilizing guided Sama Vritti (4-4-4-4) and Pranayama Restoration (4-7-8) concentric animations to rapidly reset autonomic nervous system arousal during moments of distraction.

commentary: Vyasa asserts that serene mental clarity (Chitta Prasadanam) is attained by systematically cultivating friendliness (Maitri) toward the joyful, compassion (Karuna) toward the distressed, benevolent joy (Mudita) toward the virtuous, and objective detachment (Upeksha) toward the negative, neutralizing jealousy and resentment.
application: Directly guides the Social Relational Engine, providing interactive cognitive reflection prompts for countering modern peer comparison, academic rivalry, and toxic social media feeds.
